patterns.note: Asymmetric split-screen layouts are frequently used for hero and content sections, often pairing a full-bleed image on one side with text or a solid color block on the other.
Extreme scale contrast is a key feature, with very large, condensed, uppercase sans-serif fonts dominating headings and display text, while body copy is set in a smaller, more standard sans-serif.
A high-contrast palette is employed, centered around a vibrant, almost neon orange, stark black, clean white, and a muted light grey, used in large, solid blocks to define sections.

A full-width, bright orange section with oversized text acts as a persistent sticky element at the bottom of the viewport, with subsequent main content sections scrolling *over* it, creating a layered depth effect.
The initial hero image features a subtle parallax scroll effect, where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground text as the user scrolls.
Content is organized into distinct, often full-viewport-height sections that transition by scrolling vertically, frequently using full-bleed color blocks as visual separators or backgrounds.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a sticky top navigation bar that remains visible throughout the scroll. Main content sections are designed to occupy a significant portion of the viewport height, transitioning by scrolling vertically.

A distinctive full-width, full-height orange section with oversized typography is introduced early in the scroll, then becomes a sticky element at the bottom of the viewport, with subsequent content sections scrolling *above* it, creating a layered effect. This could be achieved using CSS position: sticky or JavaScript scroll-triggered animations.

The initial hero image employs a parallax scrolling effect, where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, enhancing depth. This can be implemented with CSS transforms or JavaScript, potentially leveraging the detected canvas or css-keyframes animation tech.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed, uppercase headings (up to ~8x body text) create a bold, editorial statement, while body text is set in a legible, regular sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, from section edges to image containers, contributing to a crisp, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in hero and full-screen text sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing typography to breathe. The gallery grid is dense but with consistent small gutters.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of a vibrant, almost neon orange as a dominant brand color, paired with extremely oversized, condensed typography. This bold aesthetic is further enhanced by a unique scroll interaction where a full-width orange section acts as a sticky base layer, with other content sections scrolling over it, creating a dynamic and memorable visual experience.
